sources.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides; title slide 'Presented on October 28, 2026'), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 37, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - APAC', lists 65 APAC IBX data centers by metro and category. For Melbourne it lists four, all Stabilized and Owned: ME1, ME2, ME4 and ME5. For Hong Kong it lists six: Stabilized HK2, HK3, HK4 and HK5; Expansion HK1; New HK6; all six in the Leased column. No APAC entry is marked with the slide's 'Status Change' highlight, and the footnote says the stabilized/expansion/new categorisation is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025, and Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with an expected expansion of one or more additional phases or a redevelopment. Slide 30 reports Q3 2026 cabinets billed and recurring revenues for the 193 stabilized and 52 expansion IBX data centers. The presentation thus states that ME1, ME2, HK1, HK2, HK3 and HK4 are operating Equinix IBX data centers in its portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (HK1 at least in its first phase). sources.title: Equinix Q3 2026 earnings presentation (28 October 2026), slide 35 Data Center Portfolio Composition - AMER, slide 30 Adjusted NOI Composition and slide 47 Definitions
sources.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 36, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - EMEA', lists by metro the IBX data centers in the Stabilized, Expansion, New, Acquisition and xScale columns and whether each is Owned or Leased. Zurich: count 3; Stabilized ZH2; Expansion ZH4 and ZH5; Owned ZH5; Leased ZH2 and ZH4. Geneva: count 2; Stabilized GV1 and GV2; Owned GV2; Leased GV1. Madrid: count 6; Stabilized MD1, MD2 and MD6; New MD5; xScale MD3x and MD4x; Owned MD2, MD3x, MD4x and MD5; Leased MD1 and MD6. Its Status Change rows are empty and the EMEA change summary names only PA12x (Paris xScale); the footnotes say atNorth joint-venture assets are excluded and that the stabilized/expansion/new categorisation is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025, New Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating on or after that date, and Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with one or more further phases expected or a new phase or redevelopment opened on or after that date. The presentation thus states that ZH2, ZH4, ZH5, GV1, GV2 and MD6 are operating Equinix IBX data centers in its portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (for ZH4 and ZH5, at least their first phase). No address, capacity per IBX or opening date is given.
